caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table predominantly in shades of brown and reddish-brown, with intricate detailing. The table has three drawers—the central one being larger—and features ornate handles in metallic tones. The legs are turned and decorative, with bulbous elements, and are connected by an ornately curved stretcher that includes a central rounded finial. Above the table, there are three rectangular decorative panels. The leftmost panel is bordered in gold and features a plain reddish-brown center. The middle rectangle is bordered in gold and has a black background with an intricate, symmetrical gold pattern. The right rectangle is bordered in black and displays a design with black iconography over a reddish-brown background. The entire composition is on a light, neutral background.
title: Low Boy
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
